# Dr. Hanadi Khamiri — Aesthetic Dentist & Invisible Orthodontics Dubai

> Dr. Hanadi Khamiri is a luxury aesthetic and general dentist in Al Safa, Dubai, specializing in invisible orthodontics orthodontics, custom ultra-thin porcelain veneers, digital smile design, and Guided Biofilm Therapy (GBT). With over 11 years of clinical mastery at Bin Arab Dental Centre, she combines artistic facial harmony with cutting-edge iTero Lumina 3D digital precision.

## Core Dental Treatments in Dubai
- [Invisible Orthodontics](https://drhanadikhamiri.com/#services): Discreet, custom-engineered invisible orthodontics. Utilizing iTero Lumina 3D digital scanning, Dr. Hanadi provides predictive treatment simulations and tailored orthodontic movement for adults and teens.
- [Porcelain Veneers & Smile Makeovers](https://drhanadikhamiri.com/#services): Custom-crafted, ultra-thin ceramic restorations designed to correct alignment, color, and shape while preserving natural tooth structure.
- [Guided Biofilm Therapy (GBT) Tooth Spa](https://drhanadikhamiri.com/#technology): Gentle, warm-water dental prophylaxis using Swiss EMS AIRFLOW technology for stain and biofilm removal without scraping or discomfort.
- [Aesthetic Restorations & Zirconia Crowns](https://drhanadikhamiri.com/#services): High-strength, metal-free ceramic restorations that mirror the translucency and durability of natural tooth enamel.
